name: Double-Leg Kick
description: Lying face down with your hands clasped behind your back, kick both heels toward your seat, then straighten your legs and arms and lift your chest.

source.title: Online Pilates Classes: Joseph Pilates' 34 mat exercises

setup: Lie face down, head turned to one side, hands clasped high on your back.
cues: Elbows toward the floor as you kick.
Reach your hands toward your feet to lift.
Legs stay on the mat as you lift.

keyframes.name: Kick
keyframes.cue: Face down, hands clasped behind your back, kick both heels toward your seat.

keyframes.name: Extend
keyframes.cue: Straighten your arms toward your feet and lift your chest.

prescription.note: Move with control and breathe steadily; quality before quantity.
